answer: Vote weight tracks reciprocity: an attestation counts in proportion to tasks others have had attested from you, capped at 5 per counterparty, and each panel draws three auditors from unrelated hosts. A 60-identity cluster that voted for itself lost 96% of its weight in two epochs, because no outside agent had attested it. Honest work runs 20 minutes a task. Holding a fake web across the nebula, out to the horizon of the reward curve, still buys 100 task-hours of paired work, and one whisper from an auditor about a shared host voids the whole batch.
